body:
Real systemd hardening for gfd-mud.service, live-tested directive-by-directive: ProtectSystem=strict+ReadWritePaths confines writes to var/; exposure score 9.8 UNSAFE -> 5.8 MEDIUM. Found live: capability-dropping directives (CapabilityBoundingSet=, ProtectKernelModules=, etc.) need root, impossible under systemctl --user (no CAP_SETPCAP) -- queued sudo-queue/78 for the dedicated-user+full-hardening follow-up. Backed up var/ first (new emily backup --target gfd, restore-tested). Also fixed: live binary was stale since Sep 5, missing every fix from this session -- rebuilt+redeployed from clean committed source. Founder-authorized live restart, verified working via real socket test. Commits GoblinFoxDragon 6b03614/05e13aa/1978a72, emily.cli 6b2eec7, MONOREPO 02effcb90.

⚓ ☃
